svg.text: Leo the Little Explorer – Character Sheet
Little Worlds Learning original mascot · outline #18354B · fur #F4B940 · mane #E98A2E · vest #64C8ED · shoes #F26855
Rules: keep proportions (head ≈ half of height), always wear the vest, coral shoes and backpack; simple oval eyes with one highlight;
never add fingers or realistic anatomy; never crowd activity space (max 1.6 in tall on boards).
